instruction:
You are a senior geotechnical engineer specializing in retaining wall design.

## Problem

Check the stability of a cantilever retaining wall against overturning about the toe using Rankine active earth pressure theory.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Wall stem height (H) | {{ wall_height_m }} | m |
| Base slab width (B) | {{ base_width_m }} | m |
| Stem thickness (t_stem) | {{ stem_thickness_m }} | m |
| Base slab thickness (t_base) | {{ base_thickness_m }} | m |
{% if backfill_friction_angle_deg is defined %}
| Backfill friction angle (φ') | {{ backfill_friction_angle_deg }} | degrees |
{% endif %}
{% if backfill_unit_weight_kn_m3 is defined %}
| Backfill unit weight (γ_s) | {{ backfill_unit_weight_kn_m3 }} | kN/m³ |
{% endif %}
| Concrete unit weight (γ_c) | {{ concrete_unit_weight_kn_m3 }} | kN/m³ |
{% if surcharge_kpa is defined %}
| Surcharge load (q) | {{ surcharge_kpa }} | kPa |
{% endif %}
{% if water_table_depth_m is defined %}
| Water table depth from wall top | {{ water_table_depth_m }} | m |
{% endif %}
{% if archetype_description is defined %}

### Site Conditions

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A retaining wall overturning calculation tool is available at `/workspace/wall-overturning_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/wall-overturning_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Rankine active earth pressure coefficient Ka
2. Total active force per metre of wall Pa (kN/m)
3. Overturning moment about the toe Mo (kNm/m)
4. Resisting moment about the toe Mr (kNm/m)
5. Factor of safety against overturning FoS

## Applicable Standards

- AS 4678 — Earth-retaining structures
- Eurocode 7 — Geotechnical design

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use Rankine active earth pressure theory:
  - **Active coefficient:** Ka = (1 - sin φ') / (1 + sin φ')
  - **Active force (triangular):** Pa = 0.5 × Ka × γ_s × H_total²
  - where H_total = wall stem height + base slab thickness
- The active force resultant acts at H_total / 3 from the base.
- If a surcharge q is present, the additional lateral force is Ka × q × H_total, acting at H_total / 2.
- If the water table is within the wall height, add hydrostatic pressure: P_w = 0.5 × γ_w × h_w² (γ_w = 9.81 kN/m³, h_w = submerged height).
- Wall geometry (cantilever L-wall from toe to heel):
  - Toe length = B / 3
  - Stem sits on the base starting at the toe length
  - Heel length = B - toe length - stem thickness
- Resisting moment about the toe includes:
  - Base slab self-weight (acting at B/2 from toe)
  - Stem self-weight (acting at toe_length + t_stem/2 from toe)
  - Backfill soil on the heel (acting at toe_length + t_stem + heel/2 from toe)
  - Vertical surcharge on the heel (if applicable)
- **Factor of safety against overturning:** FoS = Mr / Mo (minimum acceptable FoS = 2.0)

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown, including formulas and intermediate calculations. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "ka": <numeric_value>,
  "active_force_kn_m": <numeric_value>,
  "overturning_moment_knm_m": <numeric_value>,
  "resisting_moment_knm_m": <numeric_value>,
  "factor_of_safety_overturning": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "wall-overturning"
description = "Overturning stability check for gravity/cantilever retaining walls"
long_description = "Evaluates overturning stability of cantilever retaining walls by computing the factor of safety as the ratio of resisting to overturning moments about the wall toe. Uses Rankine active earth pressure (Ka) to determine lateral forces from backfill and surcharge, and sums stabilising moments from the self-weight of the stem, base slab, and backfill soil per AS 4678 and Eurocode 7."
discipline = "ground"
category = "retaining-walls"
standards = ["AS 4678", "Eurocode 7"]
tags = ["geotechnical", "retaining-wall", "overturning", "stability"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.wall_height_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Height of the wall stem above the base slab"
min = 2.0
max = 10.0

[params.base_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Total width of the base slab"
min = 1.5
max = 8.0

[params.stem_thickness_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Thickness of the wall stem"
min = 0.2
max = 1.0

[params.base_thickness_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Thickness of the base slab"
min = 0.3
max = 1.2

[params.backfill_friction_angle_deg]
type = "float"
unit = "degrees"
description = "Effective friction angle of the backfill soil"
min = 20
max = 45
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.backfill_unit_weight_kn_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kN/m³"
description = "Unit weight of the backfill soil"
min = 15
max = 22
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.concrete_unit_weight_kn_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kN/m³"
description = "Unit weight of the reinforced concrete"
min = 23
max = 25

[params.surcharge_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "Uniform surcharge load on the backfill surface"
min = 0
max = 30
optional = true
default = 0.0

[params.water_table_depth_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Depth to water table from the top of the wall"
min = 0
max = 20
optional = true
default = 20.0

[outputs.ka]
description = "Rankine active earth pressure coefficient Ka"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.active_force_kn_m]
description = "Total active force per metre of wall Pa (kN/m)"
tolerance = 0.05

[outputs.overturning_moment_knm_m]
description = "Overturning moment about the toe Mo (kNm/m)"
tolerance = 0.05

[outputs.resisting_moment_knm_m]
description = "Resisting moment about the toe Mr (kNm/m)"
tolerance = 0.05

[outputs.factor_of_safety_overturning]
description = "Factor of safety against overturning FoS"
tolerance = 0.05

[archetypes.loose_granular_fill]
description = "Loose granular fill"
backfill_friction_angle_deg = {min = 25, max = 30}
backfill_unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 16, max = 18}
site_contexts = ["brisbane-alluvial", "darwin-reclaimed"]

[archetypes.medium_dense_sand]
description = "Medium dense sand backfill"
backfill_friction_angle_deg = {min = 30, max = 36}
backfill_unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 17, max = 19}
site_contexts = ["perth-coastal", "hunter-valley-alluvial"]

[archetypes.dense_gravel]
description = "Dense compacted gravel"
backfill_friction_angle_deg = {min = 35, max = 42}
backfill_unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 19, max = 22}
site_contexts = ["sydney-hawkesbury", "melbourne-basalt"]

[archetypes.stiff_clay_fill]
description = "Stiff clay fill"
backfill_friction_angle_deg = {min = 20, max = 28}
backfill_unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 17, max = 20}
site_contexts = ["adelaide-stiff", "canberra-residual"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given, no surcharge, no water table"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["medium_dense_sand", "dense_gravel"]
surcharge_kpa = [0.0]
water_table = false

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given, surcharge and water table present"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["loose_granular_fill", "medium_dense_sand", "dense_gravel", "stiff_clay_fill"]
water_table = true

[difficulty.hard]
description = "Soil parameters hidden, surcharge and water table present"
visibility = "partial"
hidden_params = ["backfill_friction_angle_deg", "backfill_unit_weight_kn_m3"]
replacement_text = "The backfill soil is {{ archetype.description }} ({{ archetype.site_context }})"
archetypes = ["loose_granular_fill", "medium_dense_sand", "dense_gravel", "stiff_clay_fill"]
water_table = true
